channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran strikes after attack on US base in Jordan
item.description: ”It’s our turn.” President Donald Trump says the US will hit Iran “very hard” following an attack on US forces in Jordan

item.title: Videos show aftermath of US-Saudi strikes on Iraq PMF bases
item.description: US and Saudi forces launched coordinated airstrikes targeting Iran-backed Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF) bases

item.title: New investigation shows how an Israeli settler escaped justice
item.description: A Palestinian rights' group found that an Israeli settler killed Awdah Hathaleen but is still escaping justice.

item.title: Iran pushes back against US as regional attacks heat up
item.description: New round of strikes raises fears of further escalation as Iran rejects Omani proposal for joint Hormuz oversight.

item.title: Fuel prices soar on back of Iran war, leaving Yemeni labourers with no work
item.description: Construction projects in Yemen are paused as rising fuel prices trigger a domino effect on building material costs.

item.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
item.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offenses
item.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.

item.title: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard killed in crash
item.description: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.

item.title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
item.description: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say

item.title: Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq
item.description: US Central Command says proxy groups launched attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.
